claim: *DocAble from the user's view.* An inaccessible document goes in; a remediated document and evidence of consequential changes come back. Internal structure is omitted because it is not yet relevant.

topology.description: Black-box transformation with document input and remediated document plus evidence output.

required_terms: Inaccessible document Unlabeled images No reading order No tags
Accessible document Described images Reading order · tags Evidence: every fix explained
What the system does; internal structure is intentionally hidden.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: An inaccessible document enters the closed DocAble production-system box. The output is an accessible document with described images, reading order and tags, accompanied by an evidence record explaining each fix. The black-box view shows what the system does without exposing its internals. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
